terms.definition: Organized teaching outline with objective, content, schedule, equipment, and evaluation for a training period.
Practical Test Standards / Airman Certification Standards defining knowledge, risk management, and skill elements for a checkride.
Students learn faster when new material connects to prior knowledge or similar skills.
Prior learning that helps (positive) or interferes with (negative) learning a new task.
First learning sticks; teach correct procedures the first time to avoid hard-to-break habits.
Repetition strengthens learning; deliberate practice with feedback beats mindless drills.
Constructive post-lesson evaluation that is specific, objective, and focused on improvement.
Learning sticks when the student is physically/mentally ready and understands why the lesson matters.
